name: Burning Bridges AI Trend: Put Yourself in the "Where She At?" Party
blurb: The Burning Bridges AI trend puts you or your pet in place of Drake in the party scene from his "Burning Bridges" video: a crowded dinner party under crystal chandeliers, a silver cup in one hand, and the Drake "Where she at?" move, one hand flat over the eyes while scanning the room.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.0 Mini, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text: [Video 1] is a motion guide only. Copy its camera moves, timing and actions, the handheld phone camera, and the warm dinner party room with crystal chandeliers, dark curtains, long tables with white tablecloths and red cups. Do NOT copy the people in [Video 1]: not their faces, hair, glasses, skin tone or clothes. Replace all of them. The one in front of the camera the whole time, who raps along with a silver metal cup in one hand, points at the camera and at the friends, then puts one hand flat over the eyes like a visor and looks around the room, is the one in [Image 1]. Keep the face, hair, skin tone, body and outfit from [Image 1] in every shot, with no glasses unless [Image 1] shows glasses and no plaid shirt unless [Image 1] shows one.The party guests around them are new people, not the ones in [Video 1]: young adults in casual clothes who cheer, point back and copy the hand-over-the-eyes move. Photorealistic, like a real phone video at a party at night, in warm light. One continuous shot. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no extra limbs.

prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same dinner party at night in a room with crystal chandeliers, dark curtains, long tables with white tablecloths and red cups, the same friends around, the same handheld phone camera, the same framing, timing and moves. The ONLY change: the young man in the black-and-white plaid shirt and glasses who dances with the silver metal cup is now the person in [Image 1].

The dancer = the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also in the big close-up where the face leans into the lens. Never morph, never drift back to the original man's face, never add or remove facial hair. No glasses unless [Image 1] shows glasses. The dancer has the body and the clothes of the person in [Image 1], never the plaid shirt of the original man; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally.

The moves, matching the reference second by second:
0-3.5 s: swings the arms to the beat, the silver cup in one hand, mouthing the words.
3.5-6.5 s: leans into the camera, the face big and close, and raises the cup to the lens.
6.5-11 s: points down with both hands, then puts one hand on the chest.
11-15 s: turns to the cheering friends and celebrates with them.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. Two arms and two hands. The other guests keep their own faces in every frame, also when they crowd around at the end, and never get the face of [Image 1]. No text, no logos, no watermark.
